mosfet_early_gate_selection.blocker: Four gate-protected MOSFETs were detected only after their datasheets had been downloaded. Because the contract required parking before download, the run cannot satisfy the frozen prefit gate and was stopped before any extraction response, fitting, or staging.
mosfet_early_gate_selection.prefit_policy: Before download, extraction, and fitting, park common-terminal, dual or multi-die, complementary-pair, depletion-mode, gate-protected, and integrated-network parts. Only ordinary single enhancement MOSFETs are eligible.
